activationBlockers: Seven PRECISE-bearing captured shaders remain rejected; twelve translate with execution proof limited to the textured-scene pair, four component fixtures, and the flat fragment paired with a literal translated vertex shader.
PRECISE semantics have no approved lowering.
Command execution, transport and retained scanout have isolated proof paths; production GPU negotiation and a real Mesa guest remain gated.
Mesa has unconditional capabilities not suppressible by zero capset fields.
Reduced capset requires new guest initialization and reduced-profile captures.
Future GLES3 requires transform feedback, UBOs, MRT, format and draw semantics proof.

context_create.mapping: Create generation-aware virtual namespace; nested reference ABI calls are one effective creation.

context_create_with_flags.mapping: Validate version/flags/profile; do not duplicate context for nested public ABI wrapper.

context_destroy.mapping: Remove guest lookup and fail later use; earlier accepted commands retain resources until completion.

create_fence.mapping: Preserve u64 fence IDs with BigInt/paired u32; legacy ctxId is command type, not context identity; map submission epoch.

ctx_attach_resource.mapping: Global resource store with per-context attachment membership; repeat/detach behavior explicitly validated.

ctx_detach_resource.mapping: Revoke future access; queued work retains owned references; no backing use after release.

fill_caps.mapping: Current profile has no payload. Future byte encoder must audit every field and Mesa-derived promise before enabling.

init.mapping: Initialize one physical WebGL2 context only after browser qualification; default 3D advertisement stays disabled.

resource_attach_iov.mapping: Copy and validate guest scatter/gather descriptors; never retain borrowed Wasm views across yield.

resource_create.mapping: Validate format/target/bind/dimensions/levels/samples and cumulative byte budget before allocating.

resource_detach_iov.mapping: Separate guest backing lifetime from host resource; accepted transfers own their input bytes.

resource_unref.mapping: Remove resource ID immediately; defer host deletion while views, scanout or work reference generation.

submit_cmd.mapping: Copy bounded command bytes; validate framing and all referenced state; unknown/unsupported commands fail, never skipped.

transfer_read_iov.mapping: Fence then readPixels/getBufferSubData, convert exact guest byte layout, write response before used ring/IRQ.

transfer_write_iov.mapping: Snapshot bytes from checked guest IOV/box/strides; upload before later draw visibility.

write_fence.mapping: Poll zero-timeout clientWaitSync after yielding event loop; complete control chains FIFO exactly once; discard stale epochs.

BIND_SAMPLER_STATES.mapping: Bind WebGLSampler objects per stage/unit; reject out-of-range slots and unsupported wrap/filter modes.

BIND_SHADER.mapping: Bind validated VS/FS handles; zero unbinds; other executable stages rejected.

CLEAR.mapping: clearBufferfv/iv/uiv and depth/stencil clears with format-aware types, masks, scissor and framebuffer orientation.

COPY_TRANSFER3D.mapping: Checked copies between guest staging resources and host storage; snapshot source backing before deferred work; honor strides and boxes.

CREATE_OBJECT.mapping: Dispatch all eight recorded typed object families; complete validation before insertion; no unknown-type success.

CREATE_SUB_CTX.mapping: Create virtual state/typed object namespace inside context generation; no separate physical WebGL context.

DESTROY_OBJECT.mapping: Remove handle from lookup; retain GL object while queued work or bound views reference it.

DESTROY_SUB_CTX.mapping: Invalidate subcontext handles and caches; deferred deletion preserves earlier submissions.

DRAW_VBO.mapping: drawArrays/drawElements and instanced variants after full state restore; lower restart, base vertex/start instance and unsupported topologies or reject before draw. No blind enum mapping.

END_TRANSFERS.mapping: Validate outer packet bounds and preserve ordered transfer visibility; payload is opaque transfer-prefix padding (including stale nonzero command words), never recursively decoded or required zero. Not a GPU-completion fence.

LINK_SHADER.mapping: Compile/link keyed variants with attribute/linkage reflection; include per-view swizzle, formats, origin and rasterizer shader state in key.

SET_ATOMIC_BUFFERS.mapping: Accept only validated zero bindings as inactive initialization; reject nonzero buffers and atomic execution.

SET_INDEX_BUFFER.mapping: Track type/offset/resource generation; validate range at draw; rewrite restart indices when needed.

SET_MIN_SAMPLES.mapping: Accept inactive/default value only initially; reject nontrivial minimum sample shading.

SET_POLYGON_STIPPLE.mapping: Store bounded 32-word state; inactive rasterizer stipple only initially; active stipple rejected until shader lowering proven.

SET_SAMPLER_VIEWS.mapping: Validate attachments and view format/level/layers; specialize every texture sampling operation for view swizzle including forced alpha.

SET_SAMPLE_MASK.mapping: Initial single-sample/all-enabled state only; reject active multisample masks until lowering and sample semantics proven.

SET_SCISSOR_STATE.mapping: scissor with checked rectangle and orientation conversion; restore every switch.

SET_SHADER_BUFFERS.mapping: Accept validated zero bindings only; reject executable SSBOs.

SET_SHADER_IMAGES.mapping: Accept validated zero bindings only; reject executable image load/store.

SET_STENCIL_REF.mapping: stencilFuncSeparate using independently restored front/back references and DSA masks.

SET_STREAMOUT_TARGETS.mapping: Zero targets only initially; reject active transform feedback until separate GLES3 tier implemented.

SET_SUB_CTX.mapping: Select virtual state; invalid subcontext fails; selection re-established on every submission.

SET_TESS_STATE.mapping: Validate fixed initialization payload; no-op only with absent tessellation stages; reject tessellation execution.

SET_TWEAKS.mapping: Explicit allowlist of pinned initialization tweaks; unknown or semantics-changing tweaks rejected, never silently skipped.

SET_VIEWPORT_STATE.mapping: Convert Gallium scale/translate to viewport/depthRange, preserving lower-left coordinates and winding.

UINT32-immediates.mapping: Four checked decimal words are preserved as float bits; finite magnitude<=1e6 only, no nonzero subnormals. Integer operations remain rejected.

declaration-masks.mapping: Generic VS outputs and smooth or flat FS inputs may declare .xy or .xyz; all other declarations stay full-width.

declaration-ranges-and-order.mapping: Non-overlapping TEMP ranges within0..9 and CONST ranges within0..7 are supported, including declarations after immediates. Other file ranges, address registers and larger banks remain rejected.

indirect-constant-index.mapping: CONST[ADDR[0].x] uses bounded index and bit-correct UARL; reject out-of-range and unsupported indirect files.

partial-destination-writes.mapping: MOV/ADD/MUL accept TEMP/OUT masks x/y/z/w/xy/xyz, tracking initialized lanes. Complete POSITION/COLOR and every declared generic output lane are required. MAD/TEX retain full-width destinations.

semantics-and-interpolation.mapping: POSITION/COLOR and GENERIC0..7 with PERSPECTIVE or CONSTANT fragment interpolation. Bounded pair translation derives matching vertex qualifiers and a canonical semantic/mask/mode identity; no caller compiler keys.

source-swizzles-and-negation.mapping: Exactly four xyzw selectors supported. Consumed source lanes follow destination masks for componentwise operations and xy for 2D TEX, then swizzles select declared and initialized lanes. Negation/modifiers remain rejected.

structured-target-annotations.mapping: Validate UIF/ELSE/BGNLOOP/ENDLOOP target labels and matching stack; observed IF nesting7 and loop nesting1; bound execution work.
